name: Riverside
tagline: Riverside.fm is a high-quality remote podcast and video recording studio that captures each participant's audio and video locally — not over a streamed connection — to ensure broadcast-quality recordings regardless of internet conditions. Its AI features include automatic transcription, clip generation, and background removal. Podcasters and video journalists use it when recording quality is non-negotiable.
